name: spo-duplicate-list-value-audit
title: SPO - Duplicate List Value Audit
shortDescription: Identify duplicate values in a SharePoint list column and export them to a CSV report using PnP PowerShell.
longDescription: This PowerShell script connects to SharePoint Online using certificate-based app-only authentication, retrieves items from a specified SharePoint list, and identifies duplicate values in a configured column. It generates a CSV report containing the duplicate value, occurrence count, list item ID, site URL, list name, and column name.
